nodes.label: Build Attempt module
nodes.rationale: Owns lease renewal and recovery. Lost ownership aborts execution and fences later publication/state changes. Reconcile branch/commit/PR state without repeating Claude; missing output or legacy metadata requires an explicit new Build.

nodes.label: ClaudeProcessRunner
nodes.rationale: Keep the authoritative bounded CLI invocation in the runner, rather than duplicate flags in documentation.

nodes.label: Model gateway
nodes.rationale: Checks live Build lease, expiry, fixed model, request policy and durable cost reservations. Defaults: US$5 estimated spend, 100 requests, one in flight; unknown usage retains full reservation and new tokens cannot reset an attempt budget. Provider billing remains separate.

nodes.label: Trusted Git publication
nodes.rationale: Worker applies validated patch to trusted pinned checkout; execution-container Git metadata never enters publication.

nodes.label: Session event log
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL is the durable source; LISTEN/NOTIFY only wakes replay readers.

nodes.label: useSession
nodes.rationale: session_updated carries authoritative full state; lifecycle events remain signals.

nodes.label: Build Attempt
nodes.rationale: Freeze repository SHA, accepted scope and inputs; use an attempt-specific branch.

nodes.label: Complexity gate
nodes.rationale: Discovery evidence estimates change size separately from profile inventory; unresolved questions or oversized estimates block generation.

nodes.label: Publication reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Recover a known branch and generated SHA with bounded retries; never repeat model generation.

nodes.label: Synthetic repository benchmark
nodes.rationale: Measures bounded local Git-object inventory and scoped search, not production throughput or generation quality.

nodes.label: Repository Profile
nodes.rationale: Partial inventory counts are lower bounds; truncation never establishes that a repository is small.

nodes.label: Repository Snapshot
nodes.rationale: Read Git objects from the pinned commit; ignore dirty and untracked state and never silently repin.

nodes.label: Scope Plan
nodes.rationale: Server inventories literal selected roots before confirming; accepted Builds freeze commit-bound scope.

nodes.label: Execution attempt resource bounds
nodes.rationale: The complete attempt and credential expire after 30 minutes. Claude: 15 minutes and 80 turns; initial npm ci: 10 minutes; final npm test --ignore-scripts: 5 minutes; Git: 120 seconds. Container defaults: 2 CPUs, 4 GiB memory, 256 processes, 2 GiB tmpfs. Individual limits do not extend the total deadline.

nodes.label: Durable bounded progress
nodes.rationale: Await persistence before more stdout; storage failure aborts execution into Build Attempt recovery. Reject lines above 1 MiB, retain bounded stderr, persist fixed activity descriptions rather than model commands/repository text, and surface only approved errors.

nodes.label: Cancellation and subprocess cleanup
nodes.rationale: Pre-cancelled operations never spawn. Unix process groups receive SIGTERM then SIGKILL after five seconds; await child closure before removing temporary files. Kill surviving members, clear timers and detach listeners on every exit. Supported Compose is Linux; Windows fallback kills only the direct child.

nodes.label: Untrusted build inputs
nodes.rationale: SPEC.md and CONTEXT.md are temporary checkout-local exclusions, with existing file collisions rejected. Repository content, transcripts and generated inputs cannot expand execution permissions.

nodes.label: Disposable restore drill
nodes.rationale: Restore into new storage, apply retention, revoke logins, and fence uncertain generation; drills remove only their own temporary database.

nodes.label: Transcript retention
nodes.rationale: Preserve immutable planning records and active frozen Build inputs while expiring raw transcripts based on their original age.

nodes.label: Live acceptance
nodes.rationale: Use synthetic content and a disposable repository, reserve estimated provider spending explicitly, and verify the actual external backup destination. Estimates are not a billing ceiling.

nodes.label: Live evaluation reservation ledger
nodes.rationale: Reserve an operator-supplied estimate durably before requests; retain uncertain reservations; estimates are not a billing ceiling.

nodes.label: Offline behavioral evaluations
nodes.rationale: Exercise real application permissions and Build gates; deterministic checks do not prove semantic resistance to prompt injection.

nodes.label: Operational hardening
nodes.rationale: Single-operator local Compose deployment; additive migrations and explicit post-call Builds preserve existing durable records.

nodes.label: Verification ledger
nodes.rationale: Records local deterministic and synthetic verification separately from pending provider and physical-backup acceptance.

nodes.label: Private voice workspace
nodes.rationale: Discuss a repository at an immutable commit, produce a Spec, optionally run post-call Claude Builds in disposable containers; trusted Worker publishes draft PRs for human review.

nodes.label: Saved Session continuation
nodes.rationale: Calls last at most 45 minutes and can continue within the same Session. Eight-hour login; logout preserves accepted Builds. Mark call failed abandons a lost callback without losing Specs or decisions.

nodes.label: Scope confirmation
nodes.rationale: Edit and save included/excluded literal paths; required Scope Plans need explicit confirmation again after a changed proposal.

nodes.label: Verification and deployment limitations
nodes.rationale: Single operator and host; Docker shares host kernel. Estimates cannot guarantee a billing ceiling. Synthetic checks do not prove customer impact, production load or paid acceptance; external recovery needs a mounted destination and separately recoverable password.

nodes.label: Verified Build limits
nodes.rationale: Node/npm Builds require a lockfile and explicit test command; install lifecycle scripts default off. Source export is at most 64 MiB regular tracked files, default workspace 2 GiB. Symlinks, submodules, Git LFS hydration and other toolchains are unsupported.

nodes.label: Disposable Docker execution
nodes.rationale: Separate hostile repository code from trusted publication; accept Docker shared-kernel risk rather than a separate VM.

nodes.label: Encrypted second-disk backups
nodes.rationale: Retain 14 days of encrypted history, with weekly disposable restore drills and an explicit transcript-retention exception.

nodes.label: Revocable operator login
nodes.rationale: Keep the single-host deployment private to one operator while exposing authenticated provider routes.

nodes.label: Agent tool names
nodes.rationale: Agent-facing snake_case and server route kebab-case are intentionally distinct and must change together.

nodes.label: Graphify
nodes.rationale: Navigation aid whose evidence must be verified against source, configuration and tests.

nodes.label: Repository Graphify refresh
nodes.rationale: Repository-local process override retains src/lib/build, tests/lib/build and the Build route without changing global installation or secret/dependency filters. Wrapper checks detection and graph coverage; unwrapped hooks may still omit these modules.

nodes.label: Semantic documentation extraction
nodes.rationale: CLI update refreshes code only; the skill update flow refreshes documentation semantics.

nodes.label: Ponytail
nodes.rationale: Choose the smallest complete change while retaining validation, security, accessibility and risky-logic checks.

nodes.label: Canonical triage roles
nodes.rationale: Map canonical skill roles to repository issue labels.

nodes.label: Separate private operation from hostile repository execution
nodes.norm_label: separate private operation from hostile repository execution

nodes.label: Historical developer-experience audit
nodes.rationale: Historical findings; current operation is linked from the documentation map. Resolved findings retain their rationale.

nodes.label: Human Git authorship
nodes.rationale: Repository owner Ashraf Rahman (@AshrafRah96); use configured human Git identity and add no AI co-author or generated-by trailers.

nodes.label: Ponytail implementation discipline
nodes.rationale: Choose the smallest complete change while preserving validation, security, accessibility, and focused checks.

nodes.label: Contribution verification gates
nodes.rationale: Focused Vitest checks support iteration; verify before PR. Browser tests cover dashboard, route or SSE changes. Offline tool/scope/Build gates, disposable PostgreSQL integration and Docker execution/deployment checks remain distinct from quota-consuming warning-only live checks.

nodes.label: Separate read-only recovery-password mount
nodes.rationale: Recovery-password storage is separate from the backup repository and mounted read-only.

nodes.label: Required external backup volume
nodes.rationale: The bind mount refuses absent host paths and requires a configured external volume marker.

nodes.label: Isolated execution bridge
nodes.rationale: Execution network is internal, disables IPv6, and uses isolated IPv4 gateway mode.

nodes.label: Operator login cookie
nodes.rationale: Protect Session reads and mutations independently of provider capabilities.

nodes.label: Post-call receipt
nodes.rationale: Commit finalization and events atomically; fence stale workers and deduplicate deliveries.

nodes.label: Execution launcher
nodes.rationale: Trusted launcher owns the Docker socket and attempt-container lifecycle; it holds neither database access nor a real provider key.

nodes.label: Provider ingress
nodes.rationale: Expose provider-only routes separately from the private dashboard.

nodes.label: Independent Worker lanes
nodes.rationale: Profile and post-call work proceed independently while only one Build runs at a time.

nodes.label: Live operator check
nodes.rationale: Verify actual audio, signed callbacks, isolated tests and a draft PR using a disposable repository; never disable HMAC.

nodes.label: Session capability
nodes.rationale: Call-bound tool authorization remains separate from operator-cookie dashboard and Build authorization.

nodes.label: Installed ElevenLabs SDK declarations
nodes.rationale: SDK fields and method signatures change; inspect installed declarations before writing provider integration.

nodes.label: Standalone ElevenLabs tool entities
nodes.rationale: Tool resources are created separately and referenced by complete replacement lists of IDs.

nodes.label: Separate operator and provider authentication
nodes.rationale: Eight-hour revocable operator cookies and same-origin mutations protect the private dashboard. Tool capabilities bind to 45-minute calls and expire after 60 minutes; signed callbacks authenticate independently.

nodes.label: Allowed-host exfiltration limitation
nodes.rationale: Registry/GitHub allowlists cannot prevent exfiltration to allowed hosts. Builds send scoped source to the model; restrict tokens, scope and allowlists.

nodes.label: Untrusted repository execution boundary
nodes.rationale: Hostile repository execution receives no host mounts, database access, GitHub publication credentials, Docker socket, or real model key. Only launcher holds the socket. A compromised execution can consume its remaining gateway budget; shared-kernel exploits remain outside the guarantee.

nodes.label: Transactional receipt finalization
nodes.rationale: Session changes and durable receipt completion commit together.

nodes.label: SessionRepository
nodes.rationale: Await call-aware repository mutations so stale requests cannot change a later call; persist state and events together in both adapters.

nodes.label: Shared tool handlers
nodes.rationale: Validate input and active-call capability; createCodeToolHandler also supplies a pinned scoped CodeSource and checks profile readiness.

nodes.label: ElevenLabs tool definition
nodes.rationale: Match provider snake_case names to registry kebab-case names, reuse call-issued dynamic variables and preserve discovery completeness.

nodes.label: Agent tool extension
nodes.rationale: Extend the server registry through shared capability-validating handlers; existing dynamic routing needs no new route.

nodes.label: Agent toolIds
nodes.rationale: Update the agent with the complete tool ID list; partial lists remove omitted tools.

nodes.label: Voice feature planning
nodes.rationale: Ground a PR-ready Spec in observed code while leaving code generation to the post-call Build.

nodes.label: generate_spec
nodes.rationale: Generate immediately after explicit developer confirmation rather than continuing exploration.

nodes.label: Build Attempt
nodes.rationale: Idempotent acceptance freezes commit, scope, generation inputs, and unique branch identity; checkpoints separate generation and publication recovery.

nodes.label: Graphify
nodes.rationale: Repository graph evidence is verified against authoritative source and tests.

nodes.label: Repository Profile
nodes.rationale: Bounded partial inventories report lower-bound counts and require confirmed scope.

nodes.label: Webhook receipt
nodes.rationale: Durable identity makes signed provider retries idempotent.

nodes.label: Scope Plan
nodes.rationale: Literal roots and exclusions use server-inventoried counts; saved edits require explicit reconfirmation and accepted Builds freeze the plan.

nodes.label: Session
nodes.rationale: Saved Sessions contain successive private calls and survive login expiry or browser reloads.

nodes.label: Worker
nodes.rationale: Trusted orchestration owns publication while untrusted repository commands run in disposable execution.

nodes.label: Historical ADR 0003: superseded memory deployment
nodes.rationale: Storage is superseded by ADR 0004; dashboard capability authorization is superseded by ADR 0005. The legacy in-memory production flag is unsupported.

nodes.label: ADR 0004: initial durable runtime refined by ADR 0005
nodes.norm_label: adr 0004: initial durable runtime refined by adr 0005
nodes.rationale: Initial durable-runtime choice remains. ADR 0005 refines isolation, authentication, retention, and backup scheduling; earlier unimplemented-operation statements describe the historical stage.

nodes.label: Generation checkpoint forbids automatic replay
nodes.rationale: Publication recovery reuses captured branch and commit. New model generation needs an explicit new Build request.

nodes.label: Server-Sent Events (SSE)
nodes.rationale: Retain EventSource after errors to preserve Last-Event-ID; server drains pages, handles backpressure, and polls missed notifications.

nodes.label: Isolated memory Playwright server
nodes.rationale: Port 3117, fixed secrets, provider overrides, and disabled reuse isolate tests from developer credentials and servers.

nodes.label: Budgeted warning-only live evaluations
nodes.rationale: Scheduled paid checks require credentials and a configured cost estimate; failures warn rather than block CI.
